name: P-8 Poseidon
summary: Twin-jet maritime patrol and anti-submarine aircraft derived from the Boeing 737-800, replacing the P-3 Orion in Navy patrol squadrons.

wings: Low-mounted swept wing with raked wingtips and no winglets
Underwing hardpoints for torpedoes and missiles
engines: Two high-bypass turbofans on pylons under the wing
fuselage: Narrowbody airliner fuselage in grey with only a few cabin windows
Retractable sensor turret under the forward belly
Weapons bay doors and antenna fairings along the belly
tail: Single swept fin with an extended dorsal fillet

tellTales: Raked, pointed wingtips with no winglets on a grey twin-jet narrowbody
Small sensor turret under the forward belly

confusedWith.howToTell: The P-8 is grey with raked wingtips, very few windows and belly sensors; the airliner has full rows of windows and usually upturned winglets.
The P-8 is a smaller narrowbody with raked wingtips and no boom; the KC-46 is a widebody with a refueling boom and wing pods.
